newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Zhejiang Expressway in placement, HK IPO.
newsitem.headline: China's Zhejiang Expressway in placement, HK IPO.

text.p: China's Zhejiang Expressway Co Ltd is issuing 124.7 million H shares in a Hong Kong initial public offering (IPO) and placing 1.12 billion H shares, sponsor and lead manager BZW Asia Ltd said on Tuesday.
The placement to local and international institutions constitutes 90 percent of the total offer of 1.247 billion shares, and the IPO 10 percent, a BZW spokesman told Reuters.
Pricing of the shares in the Chinese toll road operator will be the same in the IPO and the placement, he said.
The share price is expected to fall in a range of HK$2.06 to HK$2.38, Zhejiang Expressway said in a statement.
The IPO runs from Tuesday to Friday, the statement said.
The placement also closes on Friday, the BZW spokesman said.
Dealing in the shares is expected to start on May 15, the company statement said.
H-share companies are Chinese state-owned enterprises listed in Hong Kong.
